verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for the assistant to operate a web browser, such as navigating, clicking or filling forms on websites. The closest items are web search in Kimi Code (an adjacent capability), a help-center title for the Kimi browser extension that does not describe browser control, and generic agent-mode and agent-task headings that do not say they control a browser. None of these documents the story's capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
